description: This file is a shell script used for testing git criss-cross merge scenarios. It sets up a repository with a series of commits and branches, performs merges, and verifies the merge results.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, executing the provided commands and verifying success.

methods.name: test_write_lines
methods.description: Writes specified lines to a file for testing purposes.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares two files and verifies they are identical.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Executes a command expecting it to fail, used for testing failure scenarios.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.

methods.name: test_reset
methods.description: Resets the environment to a previous state for testing.
